body: Can you provide a HTML example to reproduce it?

> 
> 
> Can you provide a HTML example to reproduce it?

I created this repo https://github.com/mq1/tauri-issue
The issue doesn't happen on my end. What's the output of `tauri info`? I'd try updating the webview runtime to latest. Mine is `Webview2 - 91.0.864.41`.
I'm closing this issue since it seems like an old Windows webview issue. Please reopen if you find something else.

I reopened the issue (https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/issues/1953)
My Webview2 version is the same as yours
Maybe we'll find other people with the same issue
Also, do you see this issue when opening the HTML on the chromium Edge?

> 
> 
> Also, do you see this issue when opening the HTML on the chromium Edge?

No, it works correctly
I was able to reproduce this issue on windows.

Is this related to DPI scaling?

Are the folks who experience this using a DPI scale factor other than 100% in their Windows display settings?
I can reproduce this on my laptop with stock configuration.
Is there any chance your machine defaults to a scale factor other than 100%?
It's 100%. Seems like the webview isn't recognizing the window position change.

I have just put a code sample of a hacky but functioning workaround for this issue over on https://github.com/MicrosoftEdge/WebView2Feedback/issues/780 if you are looking for a quick fix.

*tl;dr*

If you "wiggle" the bounds of the WebView2 it will correctly recalibrate its dropdown positions.
Thanks for the help @nicholasdgoodman I'll patch this fix in our webview library.
